intent: The main content area of a sidebar shell, beside the Sidebar panel.
typical_uses: The page region next to the sidebar

dont_use_when.situation: A main content area in a layout without a sidebar

instead.note: The kit ships no layout component for a shell without a sidebar.

invariants.text: SidebarInset renders a `main` element, so it is the page's main landmark; a shell renders one.

From a 768px viewport, when an earlier sibling carries `data-variant="inset"` (a Sidebar with `variant="inset"`), the area takes a margin, a large radius and a shadow so it reads as a card; it does not when it comes before the Sidebar.

anti_patterns.do_instead: Render it as Sidebar's sibling, directly inside SidebarProvider

good.title: The main area after the panel

bad.title: A second main landmark inside the area
bad.why: SidebarInset already renders `main`; a nested one gives the page two main landmarks.
